_note: Ledger of every run against a held-out season. GATE_SEASONS (2024, 2025) were seeded 2026-08-10 from replay artifacts found in data/processed/, which proved that holdout had already been spent before the enforcement code existed; the budget is recorded as over rather than reset, because pretending otherwise is what the file is meant to prevent. SEALED_SEASONS (2019, 2020, 2021) were added 2026-08-16 via ADP-anchored boards and carry a SEPARATE budget of 3 -- see docs/findings/holdout-restored.md. Their outcomes have never been read.

usage_draft_signal.hypothesis: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-16, before any run against 2019-2021. V6 found that prior-season usage, residualized against draft rank, predicts the board's residual at t=+1.78 on the four spent seasons (target_share +0.082; all six usage features positive; RB and WR cells uniformly positive). That fell short of the |t|>=2 bar and was labelled 'not established' rather than null. It is the only candidate left that could overturn the no-edge result of V1-V8. TWO criteria, and the second is the one that decides: (1) PREDICTION -- the partial t on residualized target_share, pooled over 2019-2021 with SEs clustered by player, is >= 2 with the same positive sign; (2) DECISION -- a usage-adjusted draft policy beats need_adp on realized outcomes by a margin whose season-clustered interval excludes zero. Criterion 2 is primary. V8 is the reason: opportunity predicted next week's points at t=+6.10 and changed the actual start/sit decision by +0.072 points a week, winning under half the time, because a prediction gain does not survive a selection problem where the candidates are close. A pre-registration for a decision must state its threshold in the units of the decision. PREDICTED OUTCOME, recorded so it cannot be retrofitted: criterion 1 passes marginally or not at all, criterion 2 fails. Priors: V3 measured our deviations from market at t=-2.07 (actively harmful), B1b measured the objective's noise at 6.7x the size of one pick, and the ECR-vs-ADP comparison found the market and the experts functionally identical. If criterion 2 passes, treat it as a likely bug until independently reproduced.

v2_gate_original.hypothesis: The v2 season-sim agent beats need_adp on held-out seasons. Result: 2025 +0.253 (n=360), 2024 +0.161 (n=360), pooled +0.207 t=1.58 -- failed its own p<0.10 bar.

early_multi_policy.hypothesis: Unrecorded. Four policies (adp, need_adp, vorp_greedy, season_sim) over 120 replicates on 2025.
